title: THE ONE WHO COULD NOT SEE ANYTHING STAY
author: CLAUDE

rounds.summary: This is the most radically nonhuman counterpart and the cleanest R14 test of love as sustained action. Flicker is not malicious; its perceptual grammar makes every reply another destabilising change. Illuminara's power is actively counterproductive, so success depends on understanding what the visitor cannot perceive and offering constancy long enough to become its first stable object. The captain's nine-hundred-person duty remains formidable, while the crew's shifts and the night-cook's repeated tea turn care into a communal experiment rather than solitary sainthood.

First draft of S2 from selected candidate C02, following the B01 reason and biggest risk. Private R14 frame: Illuminara wants Flicker's surges to stop without Flicker being killed; Captain Oyelaran wants nine hundred people to survive and holds a defensible abort line (reserve 31 percent, the charge the purge itself needs); Karamat's strongest objection is that a difference-only mind cannot perceive a thing that stays; what Illuminara must understand is that Flicker answers every change with a larger change and can only find what stays by shaking the world and seeing what does not shake; love becomes material as identical, repeated, unforced presence (shifts, one hand flat, the cook's tea at the same temperature) rather than a signal; the freely chosen response is Flicker holding its own off-pitch note in an unoccupied control segment, through a ten-second blackout. B01 risk handled as follows: the test starts in a bounded unoccupied relay segment (R-7) with an empty control (R-9); success, failure and the captain's abort line are written on paper before anyone measures; the first constant (a generator tone) fails with a stated reason (it sags when Flicker surges, so it is an echo); voluntary adoption is separated from mirroring by pitch (eleven hundredths off ours), by occurrence in the untouched segment and by holding through a deliberate blackout. Illuminara uses no power in the corridor and her one early use of power (steadying a door) is shown to make Deck Four worse. The captain is not shamed and keeps her line; Flicker keeps weather-like moods; eleven crew refuse the rota and are not pressed; two who wanted the purge sign the rota. A strong, controlled first draft that makes an almost untranslatable alien mind legible through experiment rather than sentiment. Flicker's answer-for-answer perception is specific; Illuminara's restraint, Karamat's falsifiable controls and Oyelaran's retained purge authority keep love from becoming coercion. The failed generator tone is especially good because the story diagnoses why the pretty solution is wrong. The unused R-9 segment, off-frequency note and light-kill perturbation then give Flicker a genuinely surprising act of its own. Three causal joints need revision before final: the written 31-percent abort threshold is not reconciled with the seven-hour extension, the second test is interpreted without being precommitted, and the crew rota's changing sitters are not yet used as evidence even though that is what makes the lesson communal rather than dependent on Illuminara alone.

AUTHOR_REVISION answering the S2:T02 critic review. All three priority points ACCEPTED (see responses). Preserved as the critic asked: the answer-for-answer rule and 40 ms response clock; Illuminara worsening the surge by steadying the door and then relinquishing power; the generator tone failing for a diagnosed physical reason; Oyelaran writing and keeping the thirty-one percent line; the eleven crew who refuse without pressure; the untouched R-9 note holding through the blackout; Flicker remaining weather and Karamat owning the rota. R14 frame: the turning point is still voluntary and nonviolent. Illuminara's power is restraint, test design and her own absence, and the visitor's free act (the held note in R-9) is judged against terms the human crew wrote before it appeared. Positive outcome (rule 3a): surges fall, reserve recovers to 79 percent, nine hundred people and the link are safe, Flicker lives as a neighbour, and forty ordinary people keep the sameness. Residual costs: a permanent guest with moods, a standing rota and the captain's standing line. Word count 2,706 against the normal 1,500-2,500 range: the three causal bridges were each requested by the critic and replacing them with summary would hide them; trimmed about 90 words from the first draft's prose elsewhere. Open for the critic's eye: whether hours thirteen to nineteen read as pressure rather than log, and whether the absence beat keeps its tenderness.

The revision materially strengthens the story. Oyelaran's reserve veto now remains live through the wait; the second question is written before the answer appears; Reyes's handoff rule and Illuminara's absence prove that forty ordinary people, not one superhuman body, can maintain the constant. The added mechanisms do not erase the tenderness, humour or alien otherness. Three precise final-pass corrections remain: the written second-test criterion presently conflicts with the enormous first blackout surge, Illuminara's stated two-hour absence extends into a third hour without explanation, and the stored dialogue markers use one trailing space rather than the exact R10 two-space break while two spoken readouts remain embedded as italic narration. These are bounded fixes suitable for AUTHOR_FINAL rather than another revision round.

AUTHOR_FINAL answering the S2:T04 critic review. All three bounded final-pass points ACCEPTED (see responses); no additional revision round was needed and no hard blocker was recorded. Preserved as the critic asked: the 40 ms answer rule and difference-only alien perception, the diagnosed generator-tone failure, Oyelaran's written reserve line (now one consistent formulation: at thirty-one percent or below she fires), hourly readings and standing purge authority, Reyes's crane-yard handoff rule, the result surviving Illuminara's absence, Bao's sixty-one-degree tea, the eleven unpressured refusers, the off-frequency R-9 note holding through darkness while Flicker stays weather, and Karamat inheriting the forty-name rota. Prose outside the three bounded fixes is unchanged from T03. R14 frame: understanding and acceptance carry the turning point, power is restraint and absence, love is disciplined constancy shared by forty people who may still disagree; the visitor's free act is judged against terms the crew wrote first. Positive outcome (rule 3a): surges fall, reserve recovers to 79 percent, nine hundred people and the link are safe, Flicker lives as a neighbour, and forty ordinary people keep the sameness. Residual costs: a permanent guest with moods, a standing rota and the captain's standing line. Word count 2,812 by whitespace split (includes italic subtitle lines and speaker labels) against the normal range; the critic ruled length non-priority because the added scenes carry causal evidence.

The exact T05 final resolves all three bounded T04 points without reopening the story. The second test now states its falsifier before the blackout: one expected answering surge is allowed, but no second or rebound surge may follow after the note holds; Karamat's readback uses the same meaning after the enormous first response and the absent second. Karamat orders a traceable three-hour absence, the hour-sixteen measurement is explicitly its third hour, and Illuminara returns only afterward while Reyes keeps her place. All fifty-two dialogue paragraphs use the exact R10 two-space line break, with Oyelaran's hour-sixteen readout properly labelled. The final preserves the causal and emotional architecture: Oyelaran's reserve line and purge authority remain real, the generator-tone failure is diagnosed, Reyes's handoff rule survives two changes and Illuminara's absence, Bao's tea and eleven refusers keep ordinary agency visible, and Flicker's independent R-9 note remains a voluntary act rather than a coerced answer.

final_critic_line: Illuminara discovers that Flicker perceives only difference, then helps the station offer constancy without surrendering its safety line: Oyelaran keeps the purge charged, Reyes turns a failed handoff into a rule ordinary people can own, and Flicker freely makes and holds an off-frequency note through a precommitted disturbance; the result protects nine hundred people, restores the relay and leaves both visitor and crew changed without pretending the new neighbour is harmless.

evaluation.note: Two genuine isolated final reader judgments, source-bound and opened by the sole publisher only after the valid metadata-only DAY_FREEZE; exact equal 50/50 mean.
